➡️Northeast of Kostyantynivka in the Chasiv Yar area, Russian Armed Forces advanced deeper into the settlement, again occupying part of the Shevchenko microdistrict. There, assault troops managed to drive the enemy out of nearby forest areas, creating prospects for further advancement in the western part of the city.

➡️In the Kostyantynivka area itself on the northeastern outskirts, Russian units are defending against frequent enemy sorties. The situation is complicated by the fact that civilian population still remains in this part of the city, which Russian Armed Forces have not yet managed to evacuate. Moreover, the enemy regularly attempts to interfere with the evacuation of civilians by Russian military personnel.

📌At the same time, the main activity has now shifted to the flanks, where Russian Armed Forces units are engaged in straightening out the front line. To avoid encountering the same problems during the next breakthrough that occurred during the freeing of Dzerzhynsk (when unoccupied flanks later led to tragic consequences), it is necessary to complete operations east and west of Kostyantynivka. Only after this will it be possible to create a stable bridgehead for further offensive operations toward Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka.
